title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented Calvin University traditions spanning student life, arts, competition, and campus gatherings.

cards.title: Chaos Night
cards.subtitle: Residence-hall competition
cards.notes: Join or watch residence halls take on physical and mental challenges in this dorm-on-dorm competition for year-long bragging rights.
cards.short_summary: A competitive residence-hall tradition built around team challenges.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin identifies Chaos Night as a residence-hall competition featuring physical and mental challenges.
cards.source_title: 12 Favorite Student Traditions at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Check Calvin’s student-engagement events information for the current format and date.

cards.title: Cokes & Clubs
cards.subtitle: Welcome-week community fair
cards.notes: Use the gathering to meet student organizations and make a short list of groups to explore during your first weeks on campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus gathering that introduces new students to community and student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin’s traditions page describes Cokes & Clubs as a place for new Calvin Knights to find community.
cards.access_notes: Look for it during Welcome Week; confirm current details with the Center for Student Engagement.

cards.title: Grand Prix Bed Races
cards.subtitle: Knight Way race tradition
cards.notes: Watch teams race beds down Knight Way during fall programming, or ask organizers about participation rules before forming a team.
cards.short_summary: A fall race in which teams run beds down Knight Way.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin’s alumni traditions list includes racing down Knight Way in the Homecoming bed races.
cards.access_notes: Typically associated with fall and Homecoming activities; verify the current event schedule.

cards.title: Cardboard Canoe Race
cards.subtitle: Seminary Pond engineering challenge
cards.notes: See teams handcraft cardboard vessels and race them around Seminary Pond; follow the event’s safety and participation instructions.
cards.short_summary: A fall race for student-built cardboard boats at Seminary Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin documents a fall Cardboard Canoe Contest in which students handcraft cardboard vessels and race them around Seminary Pond.
cards.source_title: 12 Favorite Student Traditions at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current event date, rules, and safety requirements with its organizers.

cards.title: MidKnight Madness
cards.subtitle: Basketball-season kickoff
cards.notes: Bring a costume and catch the basketball lineup introductions, themed games, and dunk contest when the event returns to the calendar.
cards.short_summary: A costumed kickoff that introduces Calvin’s basketball teams.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin describes MidKnight Madness as a tradition and documents costume contests, games, basketball lineup introductions, and a dunk contest.
cards.source_title: 12 Favorite Student Traditions at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Check the athletics and student-engagement calendars for the current schedule.

cards.title: Dance Guild
cards.subtitle: Student dance showcases
cards.notes: Attend a fall or spring showcase, or explore Dance Guild participation through Calvin’s student-organization channels.
cards.short_summary: A long-running student dance organization with seasonal performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin states that Dance Guild was founded more than 40 years ago and presents fall and spring shows.
cards.source_title: 12 Favorite Student Traditions at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Performance and participation details vary by semester; verify current listings before attending.

cards.title: Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Commons Lawn gathering
cards.notes: Meet on Commons Lawn in early December for the annual lighting and caroling gathering; dress for winter conditions.
cards.short_summary: An annual early-December campus lighting and caroling gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin documents an annual Christmas Tree Lighting on Commons Lawn with caroling as part of the evening.
cards.source_title: 12 Favorite Student Traditions at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current December date and weather plan through Calvin event listings.

cards.title: The Rivalry
cards.subtitle: Calvin–Hope basketball matchup
cards.notes: Follow the current basketball schedule and support the Knights at a Calvin–Hope matchup from the designated spectator areas.
cards.short_summary: Calvin’s long-running basketball rivalry with Hope College.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin’s alumni association describes the Calvin–Hope rivalry as spanning 104 years and 212 games.
cards.access_notes: Game locations, tickets, and attendance procedures vary; consult the current athletics schedule.

cards.title: January Series
cards.subtitle: Winter speaker series
cards.notes: Choose one speaker session that fits your interests and check the program page for the current venue or livestream information.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Calvin speaker series centered on public conversation and ideas.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin identifies the January Series as a tradition and describes it as featuring speakers, topics, and conversation.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current January program, access details, and any registration requirements.

cards.title: Rangeela
cards.subtitle: International student cultural showcase
cards.notes: Attend the showcase to experience student presentations from different cultures, or contact intercultural student programs about getting involved.
cards.short_summary: An international student cultural showcase established at Calvin in 1996.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin states that Rangeela is an international student cultural showcase that has brought global cultures to Grand Rapids since 1996.
cards.source_title: 12 Favorite Student Traditions at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Verify the current showcase date, venue, and participation process with Calvin’s event listings.
